{"consolidated_memory":"## Intermittent EOF in crypto/tls/handshake.go — Multiple Occasions

**Component:** crypto/tls/handshake.go (security side)  
**Problem signature:** Intermittent EOF (unexpected end of stream during handshake negotiation)  
**Common repro pattern:** Open many short lived connections in a row  
**Context:** All work in the same corner of code; context carried over from earlier intermittent EOF work.

---

### Occasion 1: [2026-01-20]
**Trigger:** Sessions arriving through OAuth provider  
**Root cause:** Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing  
**Measured outcome:** Flaky test went from 90 failures per 100 runs to zero  
**Fix:** Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest  
**PR #3060, branch fix/intermittent-eof-1**

### Occasion 2: [2026-01-28]
**Trigger:** Jobs scheduled across midnight boundary  
**Root cause:** Race condition in lazy initialisation  
**Measured outcome:** Memory settled at 803 MB instead of climbing past 3 GB  
**Fix:** Guarded the init with a double-checked lock  
**PR #5617, branch fix/intermittent-eof-2**

### Occasion 3: [2026-04-03]
**Trigger:** After client had already retried once  
**Root cause:** Config loader reading the wrong environment file  
**Measured outcome:** Alert stayed quiet for 74 consecutive days  
**Fix:** Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity  
**PR #5825, branch fix/intermittent-eof-3**

### Occasion 4: [2026-06-01]
**Trigger:** Payloads above roughly two megabytes  
**Root cause:** Unbounded retry loop with no backoff  
**Measured outcome:** Job finished in 23 minutes instead of 4 hours  
**Fix:** Capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter  
**PR #7029, branch fix/intermittent-eof-4**

### Occasion 5: [2026-06-27]
**Trigger:** Two requests raced on the same key  
**Root cause:** Listener registered but never removed  
**Measured outcome:** p99 latency fell from 9.9 s to 867 ms  
**Fix:** Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test  
**PR #7062, branch fix/intermittent-eof-5**

### Occasion 6: [2026-08-11]
**Trigger:** Clients still pinned to the v1 SDK  
**Root cause:** Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction  
**Measured outcome:** 15 duplicate rows a day stopped being written  
**Fix:** Wrapped both writes in one transaction  
**PR #8122, branch fix/intermittent-eof-6**"}
